resources.string: Seeking, started-episode downloads, streaming cache and media buttons.
App theme, paired colors, and comfortable interface sizing.
Current connection, synchronization state, and safe diagnostics.
This number is shown on the player control.
Now Playing is softly lit with the colours of the episode cover.
In the night theme the sky follows the real sun where you are and the accents follow the sky; in Now Playing it takes the colour of the cover. The sun needs your approximate location.
The skies are off: the app doesn\'t know where you are and assumes no city.
The app reads your location once and keeps a rough point (about 10 km) in its own settings to place the sun. It is sent nowhere. Detect it again with the button when you move.
The app updates the rough point by itself while it is open, at most every few hours, for when you travel to another city. The point stays in the app\'s settings and is sent nowhere.
Could not detect the location. Check that location is turned on.
Without access to location the skies stay off.
To turn the skies on, choose how to detect the location.
A garland over the cover, light snow on Now Playing and a dusting of snow on cards. On schedule: 25 December to 7 January, in the winter theme only.
8–128 MB of RAM ahead and up to 30 minutes behind for seeking back. Streams are never written to internal storage; only downloaded episodes go to disk.
Follow the device day and night mode.
